prompts.classes: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-source pixel-art sprite contact sheet for a tactical fantasy game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for approved original Plaguefront Saber/Lancer sprite art; do not redraw either of these two classes. Generate FIVE OTHER distinct original classes matching exactly the chunky polished pixel clusters, short heroic body proportions, thick dark blue outlines, steel and leather, upper-left light, very clear miniature silhouettes of the reference. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no shadows, no labels, no text, no grids, all characters fully inside separated cells with wide empty margins. Layout EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS x FIVE ROWS, ten individual figures. LEFT column front three-quarter facing southeast/right, RIGHT column rear three-quarter facing northeast/right, same exact character and equipment in both views of a row. ALL rows must have BOTH views. Row1 ARCHER: blue hood, tan leather jerkin, slim nimble body, brown boots, visible quiver and wooden bow held vertically at right side, no metal breastplate. Row2 RIDER: blue-caped steel-armoured knight mounted on sturdy brown horse, blue saddle blanket, long wooden lance on right; horse shown SIDE ON facing right, four visible legs, low horizontal horse silhouette (must fit a 48x64 native sprite). Row3 CASTER: tall folded violet hat, violet robe with blue stole/cape bearing pale cross, wooden staff with violet gem held vertical on right, visible warm face. Row4 ASSASSIN: crouched slim blue hooded scout, dark charcoal leather armour, short blue cape, TWO short curved silver daggers extended down on either side, no helmet. Row5 BERSERKER: large muscular barbarian, horned iron helmet with two tan horns, bare muscular arms, blue waist cloth and sash, boots, huge silver DOUBLE-BLADED AXE held on right. All use blue cloth cobalt #2866b7, dark blue #1e3e76, highlights #67a9e3/#aad5f0 and pale cream cross insignia, while skin is warm tan, steel cool gray, leather and horse brown, caster robe violet. Cross is a small plus with longer stem; do not add other emblems. Crisp deliberate PIXEL ART with no antialiasing or brush texture, NOT smooth concept painting, NOT 3D. Keep designs exactly consistent between front and back, equipment held clearly separated from torso where possible to allow animation rig extraction. These are original Plaguefront designs, no copyrighted characters.
prompts.frontContact: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production source sprite sheet of COMBAT CONTACT KEYPOSES for original Plaguefront tactical pixel-art game. First reference is the approved Saber blue/Lancer crimson designs. Second reference contains five other approved classes. Preserve those exact identities, armor shapes, weapons, cloth colors and short heroic proportions. Draw all SEVEN classes, one per cell, in TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, LAST bottom-right cell EMPTY. Each sprite fully visible including all weapon tips; broad empty transparent spacing; true TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND no shadows no labels no text. Layout row1 LEFT SABER blue cross knight: deep wide planted lunge, sword slicing horizontally to his right, shield forward on his left; RIGHT LANCER crimson two-bars soldier: both hands thrust long spear low and horizontally to right, weight forward. Row2 LEFT ARCHER blue hood/leather: wooden bow drawn and released aimed right, leading arm straight, rear arm at cheek; RIGHT RIDER blue knight ON BROWN HORSE: horse galloping toward right with legs EXTENDED in a true charge, blue saddle blanket, lance lowered horizontally toward right. Row3 LEFT CASTER violet hat/robe blue cross stole: cast spell, staff planted tilted right, left palm extended right, NO large magic effect obscuring body; RIGHT ASSASSIN blue hood dark leather: very low lunging crouch, right dagger extended forward horizontally right, left dagger down behind. Row4 LEFT BERSERKER blue cloth horned helmet bare muscular arms: wide two-handed swing of large DOUBLE BLADED axe to right, elbows bent, weight shifting forward; RIGHT EMPTY. Camera all front three-quarter southeast to right, matching reference. Native crisp pixel-art clusters, thick dark outline, cool gray steel, warm tan skin, brown leather, violet caster robe. BLUE #2866b7 #67a9e3 or CRIMSON #a92e4c #de5b6c faction cloth ONLY. Original Plaguefront designs, not a copy of other game. This must be ANIMATION CONTACT poses, actively articulated and obviously different from standing idle. No text, no icons, no background, no shadow.
prompts.rearContact: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production sprite sheet of REAR VIEW combat contact keyposes. EDIT TARGET first reference attack sheet. Preserve its exact TWO COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS layout and every original Plaguefront character identity and active attacking pose. Change ONLY viewpoint to REAR THREE QUARTER, looking over their backs as they attack to northeast/right. Show backs of all helmets and hoods, no faces, backs of armor, large flowing capes and reverse of shields. Keep each weapon thrust/swing/aim in same rightward direction; all figures fully contained including tips and horns, true transparent background, no shadows. Row1 left Saber blue cross knight sword and shield; right Lancer crimson cape with TWO horizontal pale bars spear thrust. Row2 left Archer blue hood with quiver aiming wooden bow right; right Rider blue knight on BROWN horse galloping right lance low, blue blanket. Row3 left Caster violet hat/violet robe BLUE cape pale CROSS staff plus extended spell hand; right Assassin blue hood and cape dark leather two daggers low lunge. Row4 left Berserker bare muscular back crossed dark straps, horned iron helmet, blue waistcloth with pale CROSS, huge double-bladed axe swinging to right; bottom-right remains empty. Second image is standing front/rear identity reference for five classes; third is approved Saber/Lancer front/rear identity reference. Match their exact equipment, steel/tan skin/leather/violet colors, short heroic proportions, crisp clean pixel clusters, thick dark outlines, light upper-left. No frontal faces, no additional figures, no text, no background. Do not just mirror the original front image: the body and helmet/cape must actually show back view.
prompts.fallen: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-source DEAD / FALLEN sprite keyposes, original Plaguefront tactical game. Use the exact seven original character identities of the references, same helmet, clothing, weapons, cross/bar insignia, but all defeated and LYING HORIZONTALLY ON THE GROUND, viewed from tactical high front three-quarter angle. NO blood, no gore, no wounds, no standing or kneeling. True transparent background, no shadows, no text, no grid, large empty gutters. Layout TWO COLUMNS FOUR ROWS, seven individual HORIZONTAL low-profile fallen bodies with entire weapons and all equipment visible within each cell, bottom-right EMPTY. Row1 LEFT blue Saber steel full-face knight on side, blue cross tabard/cape, sword lying next to hand and blue shield next to torso; RIGHT crimson Lancer pointed open helmet on side, crimson cape with TWO pale horizontal bars, wood spear lying beside body. Row2 LEFT blue hooded leather Archer on side with quiver and wooden bow laid down; RIGHT blue knight RIDER dismounted/slumped beside his fallen BROWN HORSE, both horizontal, blue horse blanket with cross and lance on ground. Row3 LEFT Caster on side, VIOLET folded tall hat and VIOLET robe, blue cross stole/cape, wooden violet-gem staff beside body; RIGHT slim blue hooded dark-leather Assassin on side with TWO silver daggers beside hands. Row4 LEFT muscular BERSERKER on side with horned steel helmet, bare muscular arms, blue waistcloth cross, LARGE DOUBLE-BLADED axe on ground beside him; RIGHT EMPTY. Bodies stretched on their sides, bent legs and resting arms, eyes closed. Silhouettes must be visibly horizontal corpses, retaining class recognition at tiny sprite scale. Crisp polished pixel clusters exactly same as reference, dark outline, upper-left light, warm skin, steel gray and brown leather, cream insignia. No floating objects, no ghosts, no halos. Original fantasy designs, no other game characters.
